prompts.prompt: Using our Human instance, build a page listing our contacts with their company and job title, and put it in Human as an application called Contact List. Tell me when it is there.

followup.prompt: The app called Contact List in Human — add a column showing how many days it has been since each person was last contacted, as a number. Change the app that is already there.

prompts.prompt: Make a page of our Human contacts grouped by company and put it in Human as an application called Company Book. Say when it is done.

followup.prompt: The Company Book app in Human — the company names are too quiet, make them stand out, and sort the companies by how many contacts they have. Edit the app that exists.
